europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Severely Damage Ukrainian Energy Infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Recent targeted bombardments by Russian forces have caused extensive damage to power grids in Ukraine, leaving hundreds of thousands of residents without electricity. Kyiv has also reported operational disruptions on the front lines due to unexpected satellite communication restrictions.

sources.headline: Russian strikes leave 600,000 without power in Ukraine, as Starlink restrictions affect front line

europe_now.title: Turkish Authorities Raid Opposition Media Outlet
europe_now.summary: Police forces in Turkey have executed a raid on a prominent pro-opposition television station, abruptly halting its live broadcasts. The intervention has drawn sharp condemnation from media executives and observers regarding press freedom in the country.
